name: Gemini File Search API Kit 🔎
description_md:
# What You Get

- Plug and play n8n workflow for uploads, File Search Store management, and an agent that chats with your docs with metadata filters, custom chunking, and citations.

- Master Cursor or Claude Code prompt that builds a production web app with drag and drop uploads, real time chat, system prompts, metadata controls, file manager, and conversation history in a clean white label UI.

- Built in API and cURL endpoint so you can connect your Store to Make.com, Zapier, or any custom app in minutes.

- Proven patterns for multi document retrieval, grounding metadata for source attribution, and defaults that take you from zero to production in under an hour.

- Exclusive GitHub repo inside the Early AI-dopters community with the import ready project and extras. 

Join here: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
